acceptanceCriteria: The repository contains a compiling Rust workspace with the declared Domain, Application, Infrastructure, Runtime, and CLI boundaries.
All requested placeholder modules, traits, structs, READMEs, and directories exist without implementing real Goods Intelligence behavior.

Dependency direction is enforced and documented as goods-domain -> goods-application -> goods-infrastructure -> goods-runtime -> goods-garden-cli; Domain has no transport, persistence, provider, runtime, or CLI dependencies.

Repository-owned human-facing documentation in README.md, AGENTS.md, CONTRIBUTING.md, docs/**, and examples/** is semantically equivalent in English, Japanese, and Chinese using the fixed order English, 日本語, 中文.

North Star, architecture, trust, living-goods model, Phase 0 through Phase 8 roadmap, six initial ADRs, glossary, evidence rules, human decision boundaries, and Phase 0 non-goals are documented without inventing SEJ facts.
AI Cockpit attachment, calibrated project profile, agent adapter status, doctor, and verify results are inspected and reported honestly; generated runtime artifacts are not manually replaced.
The CI workflow executes formatting, check, clippy with warnings denied, and workspace tests.
cargo fmt --check, cargo check --workspace, cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets --all-features -- -D warnings, cargo test --workspace, and git diff --check pass on the final candidate.

concurrencyBoundary.reason: Phase 0 shares repository-owned governance projections and a single integrated architecture baseline; execute serially.

goal: Establish the multilingual, governed Phase 0 foundation for Goods Garden without implementing concrete product behavior.
intent: Implement the approved Goods Garden Phase 0 baseline: a Rust DDD/Clean Architecture workspace, tri-lingual design-first documentation, AI Cockpit governance attachment and calibration, placeholder reference object, and CI quality gates.
outOfScope: Sales analysis, anomaly detection, LLM Agent behavior, product personality, emotion systems, Need/Care Runtime behavior, POS adapters, databases, web UI, API servers, message queues, Kafka, Kubernetes, microservices, vector databases, and real autonomous actions.
Database schema design, concrete POS or inventory contracts, real SEJ data, store operations, replenishment rules, product KPIs, and any unverified business facts.
Binding the domain to PostgreSQL, SQLite, AWS SDKs, OpenAI SDKs, Anthropic SDKs, HTTP clients, or a specific LLM/provider.
Implementing a state machine, runtime orchestration, persistence, external adapters, or a tuna-mayo-specific branch such as if goods == tuna_mayo.
Overwriting pre-existing Agent provider files or replacing AI Cockpit runtime source code.

scenarioCoverage.expected: All workspace members compile and the declared Cargo dependency graph has the intended direction.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Run cargo check --workspace and inspect every workspace package manifest for forbidden reverse dependencies.

scenarioCoverage.expected: Domain, Application, Infrastructure, Runtime, and CLI ownership is explicit and no forbidden boundary is introduced.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Inspect the workspace manifests and module declarations, then run the architecture documentation consistency checks.

scenarioCoverage.expected: Repository-owned human-facing documents contain semantically equivalent English, Japanese, and Chinese sections.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Inspect README.md, AGENTS.md, CONTRIBUTING.md, docs/**, and examples/** for the fixed three-language structure and run git diff --check.

scenarioCoverage.expected: AI Cockpit remains externally installed, repository attachment is present, and the selected Agent adapter is inspectable without overwriting unrelated provider content.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Run ai-cockpit inspect/status/doctor/agent doctor/verify with --repo bound to this checkout and record the actual states.

scenarioCoverage.expected: No concrete product behavior, provider binding, real SEJ fact, or prohibited infrastructure is introduced.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Review the final diff and dependency manifests for excluded behavior, dependencies, integrations, and fabricated operational facts.

verification: repository CI workflow contains fmt, check, clippy, and test gates
